review.banner: Your class results are in — see patterns in your students' thinking and next steps you can take.
review.title: Understand Your Students' Thinking
review.subtitle: MicroCoach surfaces misconception patterns in your students' responses, along with possible explanations for the thinking behind them.
review.focusTooltip: MicroCoach looks at several factors in combination: how widespread the misconception is, how confidently students hold it, how important the underlying math idea is for future learning, and the strength of the supporting evidence.
review.focusTooltipLabel: Why this is the recommended focus
review.correctResponsesTitle: Correct responses across the {{count}} Mix It Up questions
review.disclaimer: MicroCoach uses AI to identify patterns in your students' MIU responses. Use these insights as a starting point, and review them alongside the underlying questions and student responses.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.title: See what your class misunderstood
step2.body: MicroCoach analyzes every response and groups students by what they misunderstood, not just what they got wrong

step3.label: Step 3
step3.title: Plan your next move
step3.body: For each misconception, MicroCoach suggests targeted next steps. Pick what fits your class and get back to teaching

step4.label: Step 4
step4.title: Reassess
step4.body: After you've taught the activity, upload the second Mix It Up so MicroCoach can see how your students responded.

step5.label: Step 5
step5.title: Reflect on what changed
step5.body: Compare before and after to see which students moved forward and who still needs support.
